Class UserProgress

java.lang.Object
aslframework.core.UserProgress
public class UserProgress extends Object
In-session view of a user's learning progress.

This class lives in the core layer and is the object that

invalid reference 
aslframework.game.LearningSession
interacts with during gameplay. It wraps a UserProgress loaded from the database, adding session-level convenience without exposing raw persistence objects to game logic.

Separation of concerns:

  • core.UserProgress (this class) – used by game/session logic
  • UserProgress – used by
    invalid reference 
    aslframework.persistence.UserProgressDAO
    for DB I/O
